changelog.name: Satellite-Icon-Without-Real-Connection
changelog.body:
* Initial release 
* allows the satellite icon to be displayed on some Android 15 ROMs, and on Android 16 
* some ROMs may crash.
* Pending fix: "update available: 1.0"

# LSPosed Module — Satellite Icon (NTN)

![Android](https://img.shields.io/badge/Android-15--16-green)
![LSPosed](https://img.shields.io/badge/LSPosed-Compatible-green)
![Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/Status-Beta-blue)

## ESPAÑOL

Módulo LSPosed para forzar el ícono de conexión satelital (NTN)  
en la status bar de Android 15 y 16

---

## Requisitos

| Componente | Versión |
|---|---|
| Android Studio | Hedgehog 2023.1.1+ |
| Android Gradle Plugin | 8.3.0 |
| compileSdk | 36 (Android 16) |
| LSPosed | Última versión estable |
| Root | Magisk / KernelSU-Next / APatch |
| SIM | Dada de baja/bloqueada/inhabilitada |
---

## Compilar
1. Abrir el proyecto en Android Studio  
2. `Build → Build APK(s)`  
3. APK en `app/build/outputs/apk/`

---

## Instalar

```bash
adb install app-release-unsigned.apk
```

Activar en LSPosed → reiniciar

---

## Notas
- Solo cosmético
- no da red satelital real

para llenar las 2 barritas del satélite en Android 15 instala [este apk](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/com.statusbarmod.hook/releases/download/2-2.0/com.statusbar.hook.2.0.android.15+.apk)

## ENGLISH

LSPosed module to force the satellite connection icon (NTN)  
in the status bar of Android 15 & 16

---

## Requirements

| Component | Version |
|---|---|
| Android Studio | Hedgehog 2023.1.1+ |
| Android Gradle Plugin | 8.3.0 |
| compileSdk | 36 |
| LSPosed | Latest stable |
| Root | Magisk / KernelSU-Next / APatch |
| SIM | Deactivated/blocked/disabled |

---

## Build

1. Open project  
2. Build APK  
3. Output in `/outputs/apk/`

---

## Install

```bash
adb install app-release-unsigned.apk
```

Enable in LSPosed → reboot

---

## Notes

- Cosmetic only  
- No real satellite connectivity

To fill both satellite bars on Android 15, install [this apk](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/com.statusbarmod.hook/releases/download/2-2.0/com.statusbar.hook.2.0.android.15+.apk)

# LSPoded 模块 — 卫星图标 (NTN)

![Android](https://img.shields.io/badge/Android-15--16-green)
![LSPosed](https://img.shields.io/badge/LSPosed-Compatible-green)
![状态](https://img.shields.io/badge/Status-Beta-blue)

## 西班牙文

Módulo LSPosed para forzar el icono de conexion satelital (NTN)  
Android 15 和 16 的状态栏

---

## 必备条件

|组件|版本 |
|---|---|
| Android 工作室 |刺猬2023.1.1+ |
| Android Gradle 插件 | 8.3.0 |
|编译Sdk | 36（安卓 16）|
| LS 构成 | Ultima 版本已发布 |
|根| Magisk / 内核SU-Next / APatch |
| SIM |下巴哈/bloqueada/inhabilitada |
---

## 编译
1. 在 Android Studio 中打开项目  
2. `构建 → 构建 APK`  
3. APK en `app/build/outputs/apk/`

---

## 安装

````bash
adb 安装 app-release-unsigned.apk
````

Activar en LSPosed → reiciar

---

## 注释
- 独奏化妆品
- 没有真实的红色卫星

在 Android 15 上安装 2 个卫星卫星 [este apk](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/com.statusbarmod.hook/releases/download/2-2.0/com.statusbar.hook.2.0.android.15+.apk)

## 英语

LSPoded模块强制卫星连接图标（NTN）  
在 Android 15 和 16 的状态栏中

---

## 要求

|组件|版本 |
|---|---|
| Android 工作室 |刺猬2023.1.1+ |
| Android Gradle 插件 | 8.3.0 |
|编译Sdk | 36 | 36
| LS 构成 |最新稳定|
|根| Magisk / 内核SU-Next / APatch |
| SIM |停用/阻止/禁用 |

---

## 构建

1.打开项目  
2. 构建APK  
3. 在`/outputs/apk/`中输出

---

## 安装

````bash
adb 安装 app-release-unsigned.apk
````

在 LSPod 中启用 → 重新启动

---

## 注释

- 仅限化妆品  
- 没有真正的卫星连接

要填充 Android 15 上的两个卫星栏，请安装[此 apk](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/com.statusbarmod.hook/releases/download/2-2.0/com.statusbar.hook.2.0.android.15+.apk)
